title: Robot Passport v0.1 stamp claims
description: The payload of a stamp, a compact JWS whose protected header carries alg Ed25519 (or the older EdDSA), kid equal to iss, and typ robot-passport-stamp+jwt. A stamp says one thing: the holder of key iss vouches that key sub is its robot, in the relation rel. It says nothing about the passport's contents. The normative text is docs/passport/spec.md.

rel.description: owner in v0.1. maker is reserved for a later version, and a reader of v0.1 ignores a stamp with any other value.

iat.description: Issued at, seconds since the epoch.

exp.description: Expires at, seconds since the epoch, after iat. A year at most is recommended.
